descriptions.text: Nicehash appears to have shuttered their website with a notice saying “a security breach involving NiceHash website” and “our payment system was compromised and the contents of the NiceHash Bitcoin wallet have been stolen”.

NiceHash lost about 4,736 BTC, roughly $64 million at the time, after attackers used compromised employee credentials to drain the company’s Bitcoin wallet infrastructure in December 2017. Compromised employee credentials gave the attacker access to NiceHash’s payment and wallet systems. Public reporting points to phishing or a compromised company workstation as the initial foothold, but the exact entry path was never published in a technical postmortem.
